name: Publish
description: Publish notes and folders as public pages on your Vaultite Cloud site: rendered from the Markdown, links between published notes kept, images included, light and dark. Needs a Publish plan on Vaultite Cloud.
forAgents: Publishing puts notes on the public web: only when the user asks (`publish.add`; `publish.list` says what's published).

published.label: Published
published.description: the notes and folders on your site (vault paths), added from a note's or folder's menu
